# Finn McCool's Pittsburgh — Irish Bar

Finn McCool's is an authentic Irish bar with two locations in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

## Locations

**Finn McCool's Oakland**
Address: 420 Semple St, Pittsburgh, PA 15213
Neighborhood: Oakland (near University of Pittsburgh)
Phone: (412) 251-5918
Hours: Thursday, Friday, Saturday — 6PM to 2AM
Closed: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday

**Finn McCool's South Side**
Address: 1501 E Carson St, Pittsburgh, PA 15203
Neighborhood: South Side (E Carson Street nightlife strip)
Phone: (412) 251-5918
Hours: Thursday, Friday, Saturday — 6PM to 2AM
Closed: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday

## What We Offer

- Irish-themed bar atmosphere with great energy and good vibes
- Pool table, dart boards, outdoor patio, TouchTunes jukebox, and sports TVs (Oakland)
- Prime location on Pittsburgh's main nightlife strip (South Side)
- Event hosting: Greek life formals, birthday parties, private events
- Drink specials: Irish Fuel cocktail ($6), bucket deals ($18), $4 shot nights Thursday, $3 pitchers Friday and Saturday

## Drink Specials

- Irish Fuel (house cocktail): $6, available every night
- Bucket Deals (5 beers): $18, available every night
- Shot Tower Thursday (Jameson, Tullamore, Bushmills): $4 per shot, Thursdays only
- Weekend Pitcher Pour (Guinness, Smithwick's, lager): $3, Fridays and Saturdays

## Event Booking

Finn McCool's hosts private events at both locations. Specialties include Greek life formals, birthday parties, and corporate events. Contact: (412) 251-5918 or use the inquiry form at https://finnmcools.com

## About

Finn McCool's has been serving Pittsburgh's college and young professional crowd at two iconic locations. Oakland serves the University of Pittsburgh and CMU community. South Side serves Pittsburgh's young professional nightlife scene. Both bars share the same Irish pub identity, affordable prices, and high-energy atmosphere.
